identity.text: Friday OS is a personal-first Personal AI Operating System + a platform core that workplaces can integrate with.

rules.text: The AI Gateway is the single door.
Every LLM call will be recorded as ModelUsage
No write/delete/deploy/external-send without the approval gate.
Ruff, pytest and CI must be green
Obsidian vault is a mirror, never the primary store.

decision.text: Single Django project; each module is a Django app.

adrs.title: AI Gateway Is the Single Door

decision.text: Every LLM call — chat, extraction, embeddings, agent steps, skills, external CLI backends' usage reports — goes through `ai_core`'s InferenceGateway and writes a ModelUsage row (tokens, cost, latency, purpose, workspace, prompt version, ro…
Write/delete/deploy/external-send actions require an ApprovalRequest approved by a human.
PostgreSQL is the source of truth for memory; the Obsidian vault is a human-readable mirror (export) plus a human-authored ingestion source — never the primary store.

adrs.title: Workplace Products Are External Installations, Not Friday Module Packs

decision.text: Workplace products are out of Friday's scope as in-repo code.

adrs.title: Voice Assistant Moves Up the Roadmap

decision.text: Voice assistant work is promoted out of the unscoped "last" bucket into a named slot: MVP 12 (the first of the MVP 12–15 slots reserved by ADR-006), with a vision section at MASTER_PLAN §Z mirroring §P's format.

adrs.title: Friday 2.0 — Single-Owner System, Agent Harness, Phase Roadmap
Owner Deletes Are Reversible (Confirm-Class); Permanent Purge Is Gate-Class

decision.text: ADR-008's confirm-class definition stays exactly as written.
Two new kernel apps, one-way contracts.
Voice is a transport, not a pipeline.
